theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProd_three_eq_fullTwist3 {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProd_two_eq_fullTwist2 {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
jmProd H 2 = fullTwist2 H

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.delta_two {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
delta H 2 = HeckeGenerators.σ q 0 * HeckeGenerators.σ q 1

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProd_eq_delta_pow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (n : ℕ) :
jmProd H (n + 1) = delta H n ^ (n + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProd_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (n : ℕ) :
jmProd H (n + 1) = jmProd H n * jmRaw H n

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmProd {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) :
ℕ → A

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_eq_run_mul_delta {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) :
jmRaw H k = run H 0 k * delta H k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.delta_twist_step {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (n : ℕ) :
delta H (n + 1) ^ (n + 1) = delta H n ^ (n + 1) * run H 0 (n + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.delta_pow_run {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k b m : ℕ) :
m = b + k → (delta H m * HeckeGenerators.σ q m) ^ (k + 1) = delta H m ^ (k + 1) * run H b (k + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.run_push {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (j b m : ℕ) :
m = b + j → run H (b + 1) j * delta H m * HeckeGenerators.σ q m = delta H m * run H (b + 1) j * HeckeGenerators.σ q b

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.core_braid_push {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (b m : ℕ) (hbm : b < m) (r : A) (hr : HeckeGenerators.σ q (m + 1) * r = r * HeckeGenerators.σ q (m + 1)) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q (m + 1) * (HeckeGenerators.σ q m * r) * HeckeGenerators.σ q b * HeckeGenerators.σ q (m + 1) = HeckeGenerators.σ q m * (HeckeGenerators.σ q (m + 1) * (HeckeGenerators.σ q m * r)) * HeckeGenerators.σ q b

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_delta {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (j m : ℕ) :
m < j → HeckeGenerators.σ q j * delta H m = delta H m * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_run {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (b j k : ℕ) :
b + k < j → HeckeGenerators.σ q j * run H b k = run H b k * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.run_peel_bot {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (b k : ℕ) :
run H b (k + 1) = run H (b + 1) k * HeckeGenerators.σ q b

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.run_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (b k : ℕ) :
run H b (k + 1) = HeckeGenerators.σ q (b + k) * run H b k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.run_zero {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (b : ℕ) :
run H b 0 = 1

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.delta_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) :
